en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a small town in a hilly landscape, seen from a wooded vantage point. In the foreground are trees and factory chimneys; below runs a curving railway line with a train and station buildings. Beyond lie clustered town houses and larger institutional buildings, surrounded by fields and rolling hills. Printed German text appears at the top, and a narrow vertical imprint from the publisher is along the right edge.
